headline: Florida Southern end Lynn's unbeaten start
dek: Florida Southern beat Lynn at home for a sixth win, having conceded six goals all season, and share the top of the table with Florida Tech. Their one defeat came at Saint Leo, who have since lost at Florida Tech.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The goals are pooled at the top of the chart, not spread through it: Florida Southern alone have outscored Eckerd and Nova Southeastern put together, and neither of those sides has yet taken a point in conference play.

wire.line: Embry-Riddle, held at Barry, are the last side in the conference yet to lose.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Four matches have passed their date with no result: Palm Beach Atlantic's against Florida Atlantic, Barry and Strive Academy, and Eckerd's at home to Trinity.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Lynn have lost one match, at Florida Southern, after winning two at home and drawing three away.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Embry-Riddle have won five matches and drawn two, scoring sixteen goals and conceding eight.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Eckerd beat Ave Maria at home for a second win, ending a run of five straight defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Virgilio Escala has seven assists for Saint Leo.

last_match.line: Lynn had not lost until now; Florida Southern have won every match at home.

next_match.line: Embry-Riddle have yet to lose and have already won at Rollins this season.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
